The registrar accepts an edition observation only on physical page 1, so page 1 is used. The words 'Alabama Driver Manual' are not in page-1 extracted text (they first appear as text on physical page 3, 'Alabama' / 'DRIVER MANUAL' / 'PUBLISHED BY' / 'ALABAMA LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY', which carries no edition), so no title observation is claimed for page 1.

passing_score.verbatim: The test will be taken from material found in this booklet.

exam_facts.note: KNOWLEDGE TEST on physical p13 (printed 11) states the fee ('The fee for each knowledge test is $5.00, no checks accepted.'), that the test 'contains questions on Alabama traffic laws, road signs, and rules of safe driving', that it is taken from the manual, and that automated testing is available. Full-text grep for pass|percent|questions|correct|score found no question count, passing score, passing percent or time limit anywhere in the manual; all are null as genuine absences, not imported from memory. Printed page = physical - 2. Not mapped: covers, organ-donor page, letters, TOC (p1-6), Parent/Teen Driving Agreement form (p84-85), contacts (p87), Notes (p88-90), online-services ad (p91), back cover (p92).
